name: SiegeScenarioGate - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: Join entry for a gate that takes part in a siege scenario (the scenario's Gates step).

steps.description: A gate the teams fight over, who controls it at the start and whether it can be broken.

fields.label: Gate
fields.description: Lists the gates in the scenario's town. It must lie in one of the scenario's districts, if any are selected.

fields.label: Owner team at match start
fields.description: This team and its allies may open and close the gate. Leave empty for the first Defender team.
fields.settingsJson: {"pickerFilters": {"siegeScenarioId": "{parent.id}"}, "pickerFiltersMissingMessage": "Save the scenario and add its teams first - leave empty for the first Defender team."}

fields.label: State at match start
fields.description: Whether the gate's doors are open or closed when the match starts.

fields.label: Damageable
fields.description: Enemies of the owner can damage and destroy it; a destroyed gate stays destroyed until the match ends.
